changelog: Fixes system widgets with configure pages failing to add, missing modern widget previews, Material You dynamic colors and responsive widget sizing; fixes uninstalled app ghost icons, duplicate icons from in-app icon switching apps and CJK secondary-character drawer indexing; fixes music widget playlist on Android 13+ and memo widget transitions on Android 16.
changelogZh: 修复三星等系统自带小部件添加后无法显示内容与预览缺失; 接入 Material You 动态取色与响应式小部件尺寸下发; 修复已卸载应用残留灰色图标与应用内换图标应用的重复图标; 修正二级汉字应用名索引分组; 修复音乐小部件 Android 13+ 播放列表与便签小部件 Android 16 转场动画; 修复小米平板动态壁纸显示异常.
